notes.title: Delay for graphical overhaul version
notes.notes:
Dear players,

In our last news we announced to upload a version during January to give you the opportunity to have a first look into the version with the new graphics. Now we have already February, 4th and unfortunately we will not manage to upload a new version yet.

As you can imagine, changing all graphics has some impact to the whole game, especially regarding size and memory. We are still working on those points and currently we don't feel good to upload the current progress. We know you are curious and we are eager to show you the graphics ingame, but we decided to wait a little.

We would like to ask you for some more patience. As a small compensation we show you some more artwork.

Yours team of Linked Dimensions

notes.title: Update on Version 2.3.2 (another Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Version 2.3.2 - 5 Nov 2020

Unfortunately some crashes were introduced with our update in version 2.3.0. And although they were rare and only occurred under certain circumstances, we fixed them. 
As version 2.3.1 didn't cover all the cases, we added another fix in version 2.3.2.

Bug fixes

	 Fixed rare crash when exiting a game

notes.title: Update on Version 2.3.1 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Dear Tank Operations Community,

We are sorry that some bugs that could lead to crashes have sneaked in with the last update. But we already looked at them and fixed them, as far as they are known to us.

And in case you didn't see the update above:
We have now built in the option to automatically upload dump files.
This makes reporting / processing crashes easier for both sides - you as the players / reporters, and us as the developers and our support-team. ;-)

You can find more info and details here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/844860/discussions/0/3004424478082385571/

Have fun with the game.

notes.title: Early Adopter Version 2.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We uploaded a new version to the early adopter branch and it has a brand new bonus level: "Fortress Metz". It's just the start of a whole series of bonus levels. After early access, the bonus levels are unlocked as soon as players have finished a certain part of the campaign, usually levels taking place in one country. For example, after having finished Italy, a bonus level for Italy is unlocked. These bonus levels give insight to other historical events to support the atmosphere of the game. During early access, all bonus levels can be played as soon as they are released.

With the "Radar Station" we also introduced a new unit. Other than that we tweaked the balancing a little and fixed some bugs. Here's the complete list:

Levels
added new bonus level: Fortress Metz

Units
Added new unit "Radar Station"
Added Radar Station to levels 8-12
New special skill "Radar Impulse" for Radar Station
Commando Bunker has new skill "Ground Radar"

Balancing
Reduced weapon range of Sturmtiger to 6
Reduced maximum damage for Sturmtiger to 1050
Reduced maximum damage for Sturmpanzer IV to 750
Reduced capacity of Transport Trucks to 3
Increased hit probability for bombs
Increase maximum damage for the BF110's bombs
Reduce the damage of the He 177's bomb attack of the He177

Bug fixes
Units are no longer available twice when ordering reinforcement
No more tooltips shown when cursor is outside the window
AI saboteur doesn't stop capturing a building
Landing strips no longer built on inaccessible terrain

Have fun with the new update and as always, write us your opinion.

Yours Team of Linked Dimensions

notes.title: Official Update 2.0.0
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,

After fixing and tweaking some things we finally decided to make the early adopter branch the new official version 2.0.0 as we think it's now time to introduce all the major changes to everyone playing the game.
Of course we are aware that there are still some issues we have to (and will) take care of .

Early adopter branch
all changes from the early adopter versions
Balancing
Special skill "Tracers" has higher range (artillery and infantry)
"Flak Post" has higher weapon range
Bug fixes
Artillery can use special skill "Tracers" only against planes
Infantry can use Ssecial skill "Tracers" only against ground units
Fixed a crash when dropping the saboteur from a plane

For more information have a look in the forum, especially here https://steamcommunity.com/app/844860/discussions/0/1629663905426078308/ about all the changes which have been done in the early adopter versions.

As always we wish you a lot of fun with the new version. We are still working on the new bug reporting system, so please send bugs to #support@linked-dimensions.de#. We also appreciate all feedback here in the forum.

Yours team of Linked Dimensions

notes.title: Early Access Version 1.8.0 - New Level Northern Germany
notes.notes:
April 1945! London is still being bombarded by V2 rockets. Before we can march on Berlin we have to conquer northern Germany and destroy all the rocket bases. Despite their immense losses, the Wehrmacht is still sending new Panzer brigades out to face us. I never thought this war would be so bloody or so long.

GENERAL, we made changes. That what we done.

Levels Added level 11
 Some changes made in level 10

Units/Buildings Added concrete walls to the game
 Sand bags are cheaper now but less resistant
 Sandbags are available from level 3
 Units leaving the skytrain mid-flight now have parachutes 

Misc Updated Chinese loca
 Added Reset button to controls options
 Special Skill “Alert” can still be activated after movement


If we’ll win this level we just a step away from BERLIN. 

Good or bad. What do you think about Tank Operations? We need your feedback and your reviews. This is always important for us. 👎👍

Thank you all.

rokaplay & Linked Dimensions

PS: Agrippa Maxentius released a gameplay video. Check this out: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L8NVYZptxgA&t

Dear friends,

Today we announcing EA Update 1.7.0. This update includes a new level (Southern Germany) and also level fixes and balancing. 

Levels Added level 10
 Level 9: Changed opponent placement, added saboteur for player, changed positions of player’s flaks
 Level 5: Removed wrongly placed Priest tank

Graphics Changed effects for special skills

 Skill “Dodge” doesn’t end the turn for the unit any more

UI Improved skill display

Good or bad. What do you think about Tank Operations? We need your feedback and your reviews. This is always important for us. 👎👍

Thank you all

Robert

It's Winter 1944!
Despite the successful liberation of the Benelux countries, our advance has come to a halt in the north. Operation Market Garden was a failure. We can't go around the Siegfried Line. We'll have to break through with force. We absolutely must gain a toehold on German soil.

Dear friends,

Today we announcing EA Update 1.6.0 and this is a big content update.

Units Added B24 Liberator
 Increased visual range of PBY Catalina
 Decreased bomb damage for Flying Fortress and Liberator, added more bombs for both
 Bunker busters can now be applied to tank traps

Graphics New effects for bombs, howitzers and rockets
 Tank traps have a destroyed graphic now

Gameplay Added sand bags
 Added landing strip for DC-47 Skytrain
 Improved range display for units (colors by frankycl)

More Options Added possibility to remap controls
 Colors for range display and terrain info can be changed

Please, give us your feedback - good or bad. We'll working hard to make you guys happy.

Please take the time and leave a review on steam. This is always important for us and you're showing that the game is relevant for Steam.  (algorithm) ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Thank you all 

Robert
